trap.label: would no if
trap.wrong: If they would have practiced, deals would have closed.
trap.right: If they had practiced, deals would have closed.
trap.why: O brasileiro pensa em “se eles teriam praticado”. Em inglês, a oração if usa past perfect; o would fica só na principal.

mcq.q: If they ___ practiced, deals would have closed.
___ the weather holds, we will finish.

opts: Unless you don’t call, I stay.

fix.wrong: If I would have known, I would have asked.
fix.right: If I had known, I would have asked.

fix.wrong: Provided if it rains, we stay.
fix.right: Provided that it rains, we stay.

fix.wrong: If they have practiced, deals would have closed.
fix.right: If they had practiced, deals would have closed.

rewrite.prompt: Críticas: “You didn’t plan, so we failed.” (If…)
rewrite.answer: If you had planned, we would not have failed.

rewrite.prompt: Use provided that: “We will sign if the price drops.”
rewrite.answer: We will sign provided that the price drops.

rewrite.prompt: Use unless: “If you don’t ask, you won’t know.”
rewrite.answer: Unless you ask, you won’t know.
